name: Fujian Furi Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Fujian Furi Electronics Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of smart terminal and LED optoelectronic products in China. The company provides smartphones to electronic brands and technology companies; and product services, including product solution design, product development, manufacturing, and delivery of mobile phones and other smart terminals, as well as ODM/JDM/OEM activities for smartphones, tablets, AIoT devices, audiovisual equipment, hotel robots, robotic vacuum cleaners, smartwatches, and automotive electronics.
